scripts.build: vp run build:shared && vp run build:all
scripts.verify: vp run check:workspace && vp run build:shared && vp run test:shared
scripts.build:shared: vp run @hewa/response-codes#build && vp run @hewa/errors#build && vp run @hewa/observability#build && vp run @hewa/proto#build && vp run @hewa/utils#build
scripts.test:shared: vp run @hewa/utils#test && vp run @hewa/response-codes#test && vp run @hewa/errors#test && vp run @hewa/observability#test && vp run @hewa/proto#test
scripts.release: vp exec changeset version && vp install
scripts.ci:publish: vp run -r build && vp pm publish -r
